notes:
Lyriix Android v0.2.7

- Shuffle the current playback queue without restarting the song.
- Repeat controls cycle through Off, Repeat all, and Repeat one. Shuffle and repeat settings are remembered when reopening the app and apply during background playback.
- Search reuses an indexed library snapshot and filters in the background instead of rereading the library on every keystroke.
- Playback queues are prepared in the background, with checks that discard outdated selections and account or PC connection changes.
- Offline music, pairing, and saved library data are preserved during the update.
